'''''Ruppia drepanensis''''' is a genus of [[flowering plants]].<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.catalogueoflife.org/DCA_Export/zip-fixed/2019-annual.zip|title= Species 2000 & ITIS Catalogue of Life: 2019 Annual Checklist.|author= Roskov Y., Kunze T., Orrell T., Abucay L., Paglinawan L., Culham A., Bailly N., Kirk P., Bourgoin T., Baillargeon G., Decock W., De Wever A., Didžiulis V. (ed)|year= 2019|publisher= Species 2000: Naturalis, Leiden, the Netherlands. ISSN 2405-884X. TaxonID: 43244817|accessdate= 2019-11-11}}</ref> It was first described by [[Vincenzo Tineo]].<ref>G.Gussone (1845), In: Fl. Sicul. Syn. 2: 878</ref> ''Ruppia drepanensis'' belongs to the [[genus]] ''[[Ruppia]]'', and the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Ruppiaceae]].<ref>Govaerts R. (ed). For a full list of reviewers see: http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/compilersReviewers.do (2019). WCSP: World Checklist of Selected Plant Families (version Aug 2017). In: Species 2000 & ITIS Catalogue of Life, 2019 Annual Checklist (Roskov Y., Ower G., Orrell T., Nicolson D., Bailly N., Kirk P.M., Bourgoin T., DeWalt R.E., Decock W., Nieukerken E. van, Zarucchi J., Penev L., eds.).
